body: R31 found it while building the stamps. FightSimulation's only finish string is 'KO/TKO', and classify_ring_method's substring test ('ko' and not 'tko') fell through to the tko branch, so every knockout classified TECHNICAL - which K16 rules is technical SUPERIORITY, explicitly not a knockout. Fixed in GameState.gd on my R31 commit: a 'ko' TOKEN (split on / and _) or the word 'knockout' maps to KO; a bare 'tko' still maps to TECHNICAL, so your ring_api_test assertion is unchanged and still passes. No other C15 behaviour touched. Nothing for you to redo - noted so the next read API does not re-import the pattern.
topic: C15 follow-up: classify_ring_method stamped every knockout TECHNICAL
